tonbridge.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of west Kent
s1loc: Tonbridge runs its summer events from the castle grounds. Tonbridge Castle and its Bailey Lawn host free Sunday concerts, open-air theatre, the Tonbridge Music Weekend and Tonbridge Pride from May to September, while the Racecourse Sportsground carries the Food Festival and big outdoor rallies along the Medway. The Oast Theatre, a converted Kentish oast house, and the EM Forster Theatre run the indoor programme of drama, music and comedy through the year for local crews.

And the trade runs at every size. Beyond the castle, the wider west Kent calendar keeps crews working through the warmer months. The Racecourse Sportsground and the riverside parks carry artisan markets, classic-car gatherings and family open-air days, the town-centre squares run their seasonal markets, and the Sevenoaks and Maidstone programmes draw production teams from across the county. From castle-lawn concerts to riverside festivals, the events trade across this corner of Kent gives local stage, rigging and front-of-house crews a steady seasonal run.
